title: stand.mjs down removes each stand container with its anonymous volumes, so a slot pass no longer leaves the database's MariaDB data (~180 MB) on the Docker disk
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-1100-p6-stand-down-removes-volumes.mjs (a stand-in docker first on PATH records every call; no Docker needed).
expect: S1 exits 0; 'down' prints {"down":true}; the recorded calls include 'rm -f -v reg-down-probe-web', 'rm -f -v reg-down-probe-db' and 'network rm reg-down-probe'.
evidence: 10/10/2026: twelve dangling MariaDB volumes (a 'site' database each, 173–190 MB), created seconds after each stand this session raised, were left after stand.mjs down; removed by hand (Docker disk 8.4 GB → 9.3 GB free).
fence: what stand.mjs down removes; not other sessions' stands
